title: Build an app
just by describing it
lines: You can build a working app on Buildify, just by describing it. Here's how.
Type what you want in plain English. Like, a habit tracker with streaks.
Buildify plans it first, then writes, builds and tests the code for you.
A few minutes later, you can click through a live preview of your app.
Part two: change your app just by chatting. Follow, so you don't miss it.

title: Change your app
just by chatting
lines: Built an app on Buildify? Here's how to change it, without touching code.
Just ask, the way you'd ask a teammate. Add dark mode.
Buildify edits only what it needs, and a moment later, version two is ready.
Happy with it? Push it to GitHub, or download the code.
Part three: design and publish a website. Follow for more.

title: Design & publish
a website, visually
lines: Need a website or a portfolio? Buildify Studio makes it visual.
Drag in any element, like a button, and place it exactly where you want.
Click any text to edit it, and fine-tune the style.
Preview it on desktop, tablet and mobile.
Then publish it to a live link, in one click.
Part four: two more tools you should know. Follow for more.

title: AI Chat &
Accessibility Tester
lines: Two more Buildify tools you should know.
AI Chat writes complete, working code in seconds.
And the Accessibility Tester checks any website against WCAG standards.
You get a score, a breakdown by severity, and a PDF report.
Try it free at buildify dot s h.
